passages.text: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and made him king in Jerusalem in place of his father.
passages.sermon:
The people of the land acted.
They took Jehoahaz.
Jehoahaz was the son of Josiah.
Josiah had been king.
The people made Jehoahaz king.
They made him king in Jerusalem.
Jehoahaz became king instead of his father.
passages.original: וַיִּקְחוּ֙ עַם־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֶת־ יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ וַיַּמְלִיכֻ֥הוּ תַֽחַת־ אָבִ֖יו בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months.
passages.sermon:
Jehoahaz became king.
He was twenty-three years old.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
He reigned for three months.
passages.original: בֶּן־ שָׁל֧וֹשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה יוֹאָחָ֣ז בְּמָלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And the king of Egypt dethroned him in Jerusalem and imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
passages.sermon:
The king of Egypt came to Jerusalem.
He removed Jehoahaz from being king.
He took away Jehoahaz’s power in Jerusalem.
He punished the land of Judah.
He demanded a payment from Judah.
He required one hundred talents of silver.
He also required one talent of gold.
passages.original: וַיְסִירֵ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֖יִם בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲנֹשׁ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר־ כֶּ֖סֶף וְכִכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: Then Neco king of Egypt made Eliakim brother of Jehoahaz king over Judah and Jerusalem, and he changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But Neco took Eliakim’s brother Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Neco was the king of Egypt.
Neco made Eliakim king over Judah and Jerusalem.
Eliakim was the brother of Jehoahaz.
Neco changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim.
Neco took Jehoahaz, the brother of Eliakim.
Neco carried Jehoahaz off to Egypt.
passages.original: וַיַּמְלֵ֨ךְ מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֜יִם אֶת־ אֶלְיָקִ֣ים אָחִ֗יו עַל־ יְהוּדָה֙ וִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים וְאֶת־ יוֹאָחָ֤ז אָחִיו֙ לָקַ֣ח נְכ֔וֹ וַיְבִיאֵ֖הוּ מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃פ

passages.text: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. And he did evil in the sight of the LORD his God.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiakim became king when he was twenty-five years old.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
He ruled for eleven years.
Jehoiakim did evil.
The LORD his God saw his evil actions.
passages.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיַּ֣עַשׂ הָרַ֔ע בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

passages.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jehoiakim and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar came up against Jehoiakim.
Nebuchadnezzar bound Jehoiakim with bronze shackles.
Nebuchadnezzar intended to take Jehoiakim to Babylon.
passages.original: עָלָ֣יו עָלָ֔ה נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַיַּֽאַסְרֵ֙הוּ֙ בַּֽנְחֻשְׁתַּ֔יִם לְהֹלִיכ֖וֹ בָּבֶֽלָה׃

passages.text: Nebuchadnezzar also took to Babylon some of the articles from the house of the LORD, and he put them in his temple in Babylon.
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon.
He took some articles from the house of the LORD.
He brought these articles to Babylon.
He put these articles in his own temple in Babylon.
passages.original: וּמִכְּלֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה הֵבִ֥יא נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר לְבָבֶ֑ל וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּהֵיכָל֖וֹ בְּבָבֶֽל׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, the abominations he committed, and all that was found against him, they are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah. And his son Jehoiachin reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiakim was king of Judah.
He did many things during his reign.
He committed abominations.
People found many things against him.
Writers recorded these things.
They wrote them in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
Jehoiakim’s son was Jehoiachin.
Jehoiachin became king after Jehoiakim.
passages.original: וְיֶתֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י יְהֽוֹיָקִ֜ים וְתֹֽעֲבֹתָ֤יו אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂה֙ וְהַנִּמְצָ֣א עָלָ֔יו הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִֽיהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹיָכִ֥ין בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

passages.text: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months and ten days. And he did evil in the sight of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiachin became king when he was eighteen years old.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
He ruled for three months and ten days.
Jehoiachin did evil in the sight of the LORD.
passages.original: בֶּן־ שְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה שָׁנִים֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה חֳדָשִׁים֙ וַעֲשֶׂ֣רֶת יָמִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: In the spring, King Nebuchadnezzar summoned Jehoiachin and brought him to Babylon, along with the articles of value from the house of the LORD. And he made Jehoiachin’s relative Zedekiah king over Judah and Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
King Nebuchadnezzar ruled Babylon.
In the spring, King Nebuchadnezzar sent for Jehoiachin.
King Nebuchadnezzar brought Jehoiachin to Babylon.
King Nebuchadnezzar took valuable items from the house of the LORD.
King Nebuchadnezzar brought these valuable items to Babylon.
King Nebuchadnezzar made Zedekiah king over Judah and Jerusalem.
Zedekiah was a relative of Jehoiachin.
passages.original: וְלִתְשׁוּבַ֣ת הַשָּׁנָ֗ה שָׁלַח֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֔ר וַיְבִאֵ֣הוּ בָבֶ֔לָה עִם־ כְּלֵ֖י חֶמְדַּ֣ת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּמְלֵךְ֙ אֶת־ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ אָחִ֔יו עַל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וִֽירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years.
passages.sermon: Zedekiah became king when he was twenty-one years old.\r\nHe ruled in Jerusalem.\r\nHe reigned for eleven years.
passages.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְאַחַ֛ת שָׁנָ֖ה צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֑וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD his God and did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet, who spoke for the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Zedekiah was king of Judah and Jerusalem.
Zedekiah did evil.
The LORD was his God.
Zedekiah did evil in the sight of the LORD.
Jeremiah was a prophet.
Jeremiah spoke for the LORD.
Zedekiah did not humble himself before Jeremiah.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ הָרַ֔ע בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו לֹ֣א נִכְנַ֗ע מִלִּפְנֵ֛י יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא מִפִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God. But Zedekiah stiffened his neck and hardened his heart against turning to the LORD, the God of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Zedekiah was king of Judah.
He rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar.
Nebuchadnezzar had made Zedekiah swear an oath by God.
Zedekiah broke this oath.
Zedekiah became stubborn.
He refused to turn back to the LORD, the God of Israel.
He hardened his heart against God.
passages.original: וְ֠גַם בַּמֶּ֤לֶךְ נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּר֙ מָרָ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבִּיע֖וֹ בֵּֽאלֹהִ֑ים וַיֶּ֤קֶשׁ אֶת־ עָרְפּוֹ֙ וַיְאַמֵּ֣ץ אֶת־ לְבָב֔וֹ מִשּׁ֕וּב אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Furthermore, all the leaders of the priests and the people multiplied their unfaithful deeds, following all the abominations of the nations, and they defiled the house of the LORD, which He had consecrated in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
All the leaders of the priests acted unfaithfully.
All the people acted unfaithfully.
They increased their unfaithful deeds.
They followed the abominations of the nations.
They defiled the house of the LORD.
God had consecrated this house in Jerusalem.
passages.original: גַּ֠ם כָּל־ שָׂרֵ֨י הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְהָעָם֙ הִרְבּ֣וּ לִמְעָול־ מַ֔עַל כְּכֹ֖ל תֹּעֲב֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽיְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִקְדִּ֖ישׁ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Again and again the LORD, the God of their fathers, sent word to His people through His messengers because He had compassion on them and on His dwelling place.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of their fathers.
The LORD sent word to His people.
He sent word many times.
He used His messengers to speak to them.
The LORD did this because He had compassion on His people.
He also had compassion on His dwelling place.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֡ח יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֧ם עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם בְּיַ֥ד מַלְאָכָ֖יו הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְשָׁל֑וֹחַ כִּֽי־ חָמַ֥ל עַל־ עַמּ֖וֹ וְעַל־ מְעוֹנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But they mocked the messengers of God, despising His words and scoffing at His prophets, until the wrath of the LORD against His people was stirred up beyond remedy.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel rejected God.
They mocked the messengers God sent.
They despised the words God spoke.
They scoffed at the prophets God sent.
They continued in this way for a long time.
God became very angry with His people.
His anger grew until there was no remedy left.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְי֤וּ מַלְעִבִים֙ בְּמַלְאֲכֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּבוֹזִ֣ים דְּבָרָ֔יו וּמִֽתַּעְתְּעִ֖ים בִּנְבִאָ֑יו עַ֠ד עֲל֧וֹת חֲמַת־ יְהוָ֛ה בְּעַמּ֖וֹ עַד־ לְאֵ֥ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃

passages.text: So He brought up against them the king of the Chaldeans, who put their young men to the sword in the sanctuary, sparing neither young men nor young women, neither elderly nor infirm. God gave them all into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, who carried off everything to Babylon—all the articles of the house of God, both large and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king and his officials.
passages.sermon:
God acted against His people.
God sent the king of the Chaldeans against them.
The king of the Chaldeans attacked them.
He killed their young men with the sword.
He killed them in the sanctuary.
He did not spare young men.
He did not spare young women.
He did not spare the elderly.
He did not spare the infirm.
God gave everyone into the king’s hand.
Nebuchadnezzar took everything to Babylon.
He took all the articles from the house of God.
He took both large and small items.
He took the treasures of the house of the LORD.
He took the treasures of the king.
He took the treasures of the king’s officials.
He brought all these things to Babylon.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַל עֲלֵיהֶ֜ם אֶת־ מֶ֣לֶךְ כַּשְׂדִּיִּים וַיַּהֲרֹ֨ג בַּחוּרֵיהֶ֤ם בַּחֶ֙רֶב֙ בְּבֵ֣ית מִקְדָּשָׁ֔ם וְלֹ֥א חָמַ֛ל עַל־ בָּח֥וּר וּבְתוּלָ֖ה זָקֵ֣ן וְיָשֵׁ֑שׁ הַכֹּ֖ל נָתַ֥ן בְּיָדֽוֹ׃ וְ֠כֹל כְּלֵ֞י בֵּ֤ית הָאֱלֹהִים֙ הַגְּדֹלִ֣ים וְהַקְּטַנִּ֔ים וְאֹֽצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְאֹצְר֥וֹת הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְשָׂרָ֑יו הַכֹּ֖ל הֵבִ֥יא בָבֶֽל׃

passages.text: Then the Chaldeans set fire to the house of God and broke down the wall of Jerusalem. They burned down all the palaces and destroyed every article of value.
passages.sermon:
The Chaldeans attacked Jerusalem.
They set fire to the house of God.
They broke down the wall of Jerusalem.
They burned all the palaces with fire.
They destroyed every valuable article.
passages.original: וַֽיִּשְׂרְפוּ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַֽיְנַתְּצ֔וּ אֵ֖ת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְכָל־ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ שָׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֔שׁ וְכָל־ כְּלֵ֥י מַחֲמַדֶּ֖יהָ לְהַשְׁחִֽית׃ס

passages.text: Those who escaped the sword were carried by Nebuchadnezzar into exile in Babylon, and they became servants to him and his sons until the kingdom of Persia came to power.
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon.
He captured the people who survived the sword.
He took them away to Babylon.
They became servants to Nebuchadnezzar.
They also served his sons.
They remained servants until the kingdom of Persia became powerful.
passages.original: וַיֶּ֛גֶל הַשְּׁאֵרִ֥ית מִן־ הַחֶ֖רֶב אֶל־ בָּבֶ֑ל וַֽיִּהְיוּ־ ל֤וֹ וּלְבָנָיו֙ לַעֲבָדִ֔ים עַד־ מְלֹ֖ךְ מַלְכ֥וּת פָּרָֽס׃

passages.text: So the land enjoyed its Sabbath rest all the days of the desolation, until seventy years were completed, in fulfillment of the word of the LORD through Jeremiah.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke through Jeremiah.
The LORD said the land would rest.
The land became empty and desolate.
The land enjoyed its Sabbath rest during this time.
This rest lasted seventy years.
This fulfilled the word of the LORD spoken by Jeremiah.
passages.original: לְמַלֹּ֤אות דְּבַר־ יְהוָה֙ בְּפִ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ עַד־ רָצְתָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ אֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתֶ֑יהָ כָּל־ יְמֵ֤י הָשַּׁמָּה֙ שָׁבָ֔תָה לְמַלֹּ֖אות שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃פ

passages.text: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, to fulfill the word of the LORD spoken through Jeremiah, the LORD stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia to send a proclamation throughout his kingdom and to put it in writing as follows: “This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, who has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, has appointed me to build a house for Him at Jerusalem in Judah. Whoever among you belongs to His people, may the LORD his God be with him, and may he go up.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Cyrus was the king of Persia.
This happened in the first year of his reign.
The LORD had spoken a word through Jeremiah.
The LORD wanted to fulfill this word.
The LORD stirred the spirit of Cyrus, king of Persia.
Cyrus made a proclamation throughout his entire kingdom.
Cyrus also wrote this proclamation down.
This is what Cyrus, king of Persia, said:
The LORD is the God of heaven.
The LORD has given me all the kingdoms of the earth.
The LORD has appointed me to build a house for Him.
This house will be in Jerusalem, in Judah.
Whoever among you belongs to His people, may the LORD his God be with him.
Let him go up to Jerusalem.
passages.original: וּבִשְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֗ת לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס לִכְל֥וֹת דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּפִ֣י יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ הֵעִ֣יר יְהוָ֗ה אֶת־ ר֙וּחַ֙ כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ פָּרַ֔ס וַיַּֽעֲבֶר־ קוֹל֙ בְּכָל־ מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְגַם־ בְּמִכְתָּ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃ס כֹּה־ אָמַ֞ר כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ׀ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֗ס כָּל־ מַמְלְכ֤וֹת הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ נָ֣תַן לִ֗י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְהֽוּא־ פָקַ֤ד עָלַי֙ לִבְנֽוֹת־ ל֣וֹ בַ֔יִת בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה מִֽי־ בָכֶ֣ם מִכָּל־ עַמּ֗וֹ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהָ֛יו עִמּ֖וֹ וְיָֽעַל׃
